text:
jen: just pushed a release and immediately started seeing edge crashes in our sample apps. hammering through logs now.

matt: what error are you getting on the edge runtime? paste the shortest log line you can.

jen: cloudflare worker log: ```
SyntaxError: Unexpected token 'export'
 at file:///.wrangler/cache/.../node_modules/redwood-js-sdk/dist/index.cjs.js:1:1
```
also the sourcemap is trying to fetch src/index.ts and 404s.

sam: that looks like a CJS package executed as ESM. two angles: 1) wrong files in the published tgz (dist missing or wrong ext), 2) package.json exports/main/module mismatch. can you `npm pack` and inspect the tarball?

jen: did that. the package.json in the tarball has: ```
{
  "main": "dist/index.cjs.js",
  "module": "dist/index.mjs",
  "types": "dist/index.d.ts"
  // no "files" array, dist not guaranteed to be included
}
```
we apparently published without building the dist. oops.

release-bot: publish workflow triggered for tag v1.2.4 (jen)

matt: that explains it. npm pack will include whatever npm thinks should be in the package. if you didn't run build or forgot files/include, the dist folder won't be in the tarball. also shipping .cjs where edge expects .mjs will cause the export token error.

jen: our GH Action publish step ran `pnpm pack && npm publish` but the build step was gated behind an `if` that didn't run during the tag dry-run. so pack produced a tar with only source + package.json.

sam: short-term fixes: add a `prepare` script that runs the build (npm/pnpm respects prepare when packing), add `"files": ["dist"]` to package.json, and use `exports` to map import/require to the right files. also ensure the module file extension matches the format consumers expect.

matt: example exports mapping that works for node + edge: ```
"exports": {
  ".": {
    "import": "./dist/index.mjs",
    "require": "./dist/index.cjs.js"
  }
}
```
and keep `main` pointing to the CJS entry while `module` points to the ESM entry to help bundlers.

jen: republished as v1.2.5 with dist included, prepare script, files, and exports set. fixed types path and added typesVersions for some TS ESM import weirdness.

sam: for source maps, either publish maps with `sourcesContent` or ensure the maps point to compiled .js sources. set tsconfig `sourceMap: true` and `inlineSources: false` or use your bundler to rewrite sources to `.js`. otherwise browsers will try to GET .ts files from the CDN and 404.

matt: add CI smoke checks to the publish pipeline: `pnpm pack && tar -tf package.tgz` to assert dist is present, a small Node require test `node -e \"require('./')\"` and an ESM runner (esbuild + miniflare or wrangler) to exercise the import path for edge. run those checks in a publish job and on PRs to main.

jen: thanks. republished, sample apps green. opening a PR to add: prepare script, files, exports, CI pack-smoke job, and a README note about .mjs/.cjs edge gotchas + source map guidance. will paste link to this thread in the PR description.

sam: one more note: bump the package lock step for the CI runner so pnpm pack uses the same lockfile that was tested. and pin the node target for esbuild to avoid different default module output between CI and local.

matt: agreed. also add a small test that loads types via `ts-node` or ` Typescript` compile check for ESM imports so tsserver/consumer IDEs won't see broken paths.

jen: done. thanks all — learned the hard way that `pack` != `build` unless prepare exists. will follow up with the PR and changelog entry. :raised_hands:
